texts.preamble: K.Vijaya Sarangan vs The Chief Executive Officer on 20 December, 2018 Author: S.Vimala Bench: S.Vimala In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated : 20.12.2018 Coram The Hon'Ble Dr.Justice S.Vimala W.P.No.33898 of 2018 K.Vijaya Sarangan ... Vs 1.The Chief Executive Officer Food Safety and Standards Authority of India Government of India, Fda Bhawan, Kotla Road New Delhi-1. 2.The Secretary to Government of India Ministry of Food Processing Industries New Delhi. ... For Petitioner : Mr.V.Vijay Shankar For Respondents : Mr.Su.Srinivasan, Stand Prayer : Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of I mandamus directing the 1st respondent to consider and dispose representation dated 03.07.2017 for absorption into [Food Safety and St India] Fssai viz., the 1st respondent herein. Order
texts.facts: The petitioner joined as Inspector and promoted as Junior Inspecting Officer in the Ministry of Food Processing Industries. The petitioner wanted a clarification as to whether the past services in the Government of India would count for pension, gratuity etc., for which there was no response. Hence, the the petitioner opted for service under Government of India. In 2013, the petitioner reverted to parent department, but was declared surplus and was posted to Income Tax Department, where he is working now as Inspector. The Government of India, during March 2017, issued a Memorandum of Understanding that past services of such absorbed employees to FSSAI will count for pension and gratuity. Hence, the petitioner sent a representation on 03.07.2017, requesting to revoke the option exercised by him on 26.03.2012 and seeking absorption into FSSAI in order to avail the benefits extended to the absorbed employees.
